pelage_geometry_and_topology.patch_morphology: Large, irregular polygonal dark-brown regions with high-contrast, non-linear edge gradients. Patch shapes transition from elongated rectangular blocks on the neck to more complex, stellate geometries on the mid-flank.
pelage_geometry_and_topology.corridor_network: Continuous network of cream-colored pathways. Junction nodes are predominantly tri-radial and quadri-radial. Corridor thickness remains relatively uniform across the visible torso with slight tapering at intersections.

dorsal_ridge_profile.edge_serration: Low-amplitude, high-frequency jagged silhouette visible along the dorsal ridge of the neck, representing short, dense mane growth against the background sky.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: A single, dark, circular focal depression or mark is visible on the mid-flank, situated within the posterior-most complete patch shown in the center-right of the frame.
other_distinctive_markers: Extensive foreground occlusion by branched, thorny foliage covering approximately 30% of the anterior torso and lower neck region.
